name: anonym-legal-guard
description: Preview by anonym.legal: replaces detected personal data with placeholders before text goes to the model. Protection against accidents, not against injected instructions and not against intent. Detection is not complete. Requires an anonym.legal account (Basic, Pro or Business).

api_key.title: API token (anonym.legal)
api_key.description: anonym.legal → Settings → Developer → API Access Token. Without it every prompt is withheld. Stored as a secret, never in the repository.

ui_language.title: Interface language
ui_language.description: Language of the mod's messages, status line and /pii: en (English) or de (Deutsch).

language.title: Detection languages
language.description: account (default): the automatic detection languages saved in your anonym.legal account (Settings → Language). Or codes separated by commas, at most three, e.g. de or de,en. Each extra language checks every text again and costs tokens.

api_url.title: API address
api_url.description: Address of anonym.legal. https only. A host other than anonym.legal needs allow_other_host.

allow_other_host.title: Allow other host
allow_other_host.description: Allows an api_url with a host other than anonym.legal (e.g. a test environment). Default: off; every prompt is then rejected with a message.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: Name of a preset, e.g. developer; empty for the default settings.

media.title: Images and documents
media.description: drop: withhold (images cannot be redacted); keep: let them through.

leak_guard.title: Leak check
leak_guard.description: Looks for redacted values in plain text and encoded (base64, hex, percent) in requests to the model and in the arguments of outbound tools (WebFetch, WebSearch, Agent, Monitor, MCP, Bash). block: stop clear cases (default); log: report only; off: off.

encoded_runs.title: Encoded sections
encoded_runs.description: base64 from 16 and hex from 32 characters in everything that goes to the model. scan: check decodable sections and replace on a match (default); strict: also replace undecodable ones from 512 characters, except in lines with integrity or sha512-; off: off.

shell_guard.title: Command check
shell_guard.description: Rejects common conversion and upload commands (base64 with a file, xxd, od, curl -d @file …) and asks for scp, sftp, rsync and tar c … |. block: as described (default); ask: ask for all of them; off: off. Protection against accidents, not a lock against intent.

file_values.title: Values in files
file_values.description: real: when writing files the mod inserts the real values (default); deny: strict mode, Write, Edit and NotebookEdit with placeholders do not run. Read, Glob and Grep get real values in both cases.

detokenize_bash.title: Real values in Bash commands too
detokenize_bash.description: Caution: a command can send data to the network (curl). Default: off.

min_score.title: Minimum detection score
min_score.description: Matches below this score are skipped (0 to 1).

ignore_types.title: Ignored types
ignore_types.description: Comma-separated types that are not replaced. Default after the 2026-11-16 evaluation: URL, DATE_TIME, NRP, ORGANIZATION (mostly false matches in code).

scan_hook_context.title: Check hook context
scan_hook_context.description: Also redact the output of settings hooks (default: on; it can carry customer data).

skip_attachments.title: Attachment kinds not checked
skip_attachments.description: Comma-separated kinds of attachments that Claude Code writes itself and that are not checked (tool, skill and agent lists). Unknown kinds are checked.

allow_values.title: Allowed values
allow_values.description: Comma-separated values that are never replaced (default: names of Claude and Anthropic that occur in every session).
allow_values.default: Claude,Claude Code,Claude Opus,Claude Sonnet,Claude Haiku,Claude Fable,Anthropic,Opus,Sonnet,Haiku,Fable
